segment.title: Segment
segment.summary: A stored rule-based query that selects Contacts or Customers for marketing blasts.
segment.description: A Segment is a saved query, not a materialised list. The rule tree (AND/OR with leaf {field, operator, value}) is evaluated by SegmentService against the entityType ('contact' or 'customer'). estimatedSize is a cached preview count refreshed on save. See ADR-000 and the marketing-segmentation-and-blast chain (member 02 owns the evaluator).

description.description: Free-text description of the segment's purpose.
description.title: Description

rules.description: Rule tree as JSON: {type:'AND'|'OR', children:[...]} where each child is either another node or a leaf {field, operator, value}. Stored as a query; never materialised.
rules.title: Rules

entityType.description: Which entity collection the rules are evaluated against.
entityType.title: Entity Type

estimatedSize.description: Cached count of matching entities, refreshed on save.
estimatedSize.title: Estimated Size

createdBy.description: Nextcloud user id that created the segment.
createdBy.title: Created By

campaignTemplate.title: Campaign Template
campaignTemplate.summary: A reusable email or SMS template with variable substitution markers and compliance-required tokens.
campaignTemplate.description: CampaignTemplate stores the channel-specific body (HTML + text for email, plain text for SMS), sender identity, and the variable list. Email templates MUST embed {{unsubscribe_link}} and carry the physical address in footerOverride; SMS templates have no footer requirement. See marketing-segmentation-and-blast member 03 (compliance) for enforcement.

bodyHtml.description: HTML body for email channels (with {{variable}} placeholders).
bodyHtml.title: Body HTML

bodyText.description: Plain-text body (email fallback or SMS body).
bodyText.title: Body Text

footerOverride.description: The sender's physical address every email must carry (CAN-SPAM). Required for email templates. It is placed at {{physical_address}}, {{sender_address}}, {{company_address}} or {{address_block}} in the body, or appended when the body has none.
footerOverride.title: Physical Address

variables.description: Declared variable names referenced in subject/body (e.g. ['first_name','unsubscribe_link']).
variables.title: Variables

createdBy.description: Nextcloud user id that created the template.
createdBy.title: Created By

blast.title: Blast
blast.summary: One outbound campaign execution against a Segment using a CampaignTemplate, with optional A/B variant pairing.
blast.description: A Blast is one campaign send. It binds a Segment (audience) to a CampaignTemplate (content) for a single channel, with optional scheduling, A/B split, and rolling delivery totals. abVariantOf links a child variant to its parent A blast; abSplitPercent on the parent records the audience split (0-100). totals is an aggregated counter map updated by BlastDelivery state changes (member 04). See ADR-000.

scheduledFor.description: When the blast should start (null = immediate).
scheduledFor.title: Scheduled For

sentAt.description: When the blast was actually dispatched.
sentAt.title: Sent At

abVariantOf.description: UUID of the parent Blast if this is variant B; null on parent (variant A).
abVariantOf.title: AB Variant Of

abSplitPercent.description: Audience percentage receiving variant A on the parent (variant B receives 100 - abSplitPercent).
abSplitPercent.title: AB Split Percent

totals.description: Aggregated counters: {queued, sent, delivered, bounced, opened, clicked, unsubscribed, complained}.
totals.title: Totals

connectorSourceId.description: Optional OpenConnector source UUID used to dispatch this blast (email/SMS provider).
connectorSourceId.title: Connector Source ID

createdBy.description: Nextcloud user id that created the blast.
createdBy.title: Created By

blastDelivery.title: Blast Delivery
blastDelivery.summary: One row per (Blast, recipient) — tracks per-recipient delivery, open, click, bounce, and unsubscribe events.
blastDelivery.description: BlastDelivery is the per-recipient telemetry record for a Blast. status transitions queued → sent → delivered → opened/clicked/bounced/unsubscribed; providerId is the upstream provider's message id (e.g. SendGrid 'sg-...') used for webhook correlation. clickedUrls collects every URL the recipient clicked with utm parameters preserved. firstClickAt records the earliest click. See marketing-segmentation-and-blast member 05 (webhook ingest) and member 04 (totals roll-up).

email.description: Resolved recipient email at send time (snapshot; may differ from contact's current email).
email.title: Email

phone.description: Resolved recipient phone at send time (SMS).
phone.title: Phone

sentAt.description: When the provider accepted the message.
sentAt.title: Sent At

providerId.description: Provider-side message identifier (e.g. SendGrid 'sg-abc123xyz...') used for webhook lookups.
providerId.title: Provider ID

clickedUrls.description: URLs the recipient clicked (with utm_campaign / utm_source preserved).
clickedUrls.title: Clicked Urls

bounceType.description: Bounce classification used by ConsentRecord soft-bounce counter.
bounceType.title: Bounce Type

consentRecord.title: Consent Record
consentRecord.summary: Per-contact-per-channel marketing consent (GDPR Art. 6 lawful basis + withdrawal state).
consentRecord.description: ConsentRecord is the source of truth for whether a Contact may be sent marketing on a given channel. LawfulBasis records the GDPR Art. 6 basis used at capture (consent | legitimate-interest | contract); consentSource describes the capture mechanism (web-form, double-opt-in, import, etc.). WithdrawnAt + withdrawnReason close the consent. SoftBounceCount counts consecutive soft bounces (5 triggers automatic withdrawal: member 03 owns the rule). One record per (contactId, channel).

lawfulBasis.description: GDPR Art. 6 lawful basis at capture.
lawfulBasis.title: Lawful Basis

withdrawnAt.description: When consent was withdrawn (null = still active).
withdrawnAt.title: Withdrawn At

softBounceCount.description: Consecutive soft-bounce counter; resets on successful delivery, 5 triggers automatic withdrawal.
softBounceCount.title: Soft Bounce Count

attributionLink.title: Attribution Link
attributionLink.summary: Revenue attribution: a click on a Blast that preceded a closed-won Deal.
attributionLink.description: AttributionLink ties one BlastDelivery first-click event to a closed-won Deal (lead with stage='closed-won' in Pipelinq). Created by the attribution job when a deal closes within the attribution window after the blast click. attributedValue is the EUR value attributed to the blast (typically the deal value, but may be weighted by the model in member 04).

dealId.description: FK to Lead (UUID): the closed-won deal being attributed.
dealId.title: Deal ID

firstClickAt.description: Timestamp of the click that initiated the attribution chain.
firstClickAt.title: First Click At

closedWonAt.description: Timestamp the deal moved to closed-won.
closedWonAt.title: Closed Won At

attributedValue.description: EUR value attributed to the blast.
attributedValue.title: Attributed Value

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (EUR for the seed data).
currency.title: Currency
